title: A2-05 · The past denied byلَمْand the juxtant

blocks.text: A2-05 · The past denied by ⁧لَمْ⁩ and the juxtant
Lesson overview

In A1-18 you denied the past with ⁧مَا⁩ + perfect and you recognized ⁧لَمْ⁩ . In the written language, in the news and in the reports, the normal denial of the past is precisely ⁧لَمْ⁩ + ⁧المَجْزُوم⁩ ): ⁧لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الوَزِيرُ⁩ The Minister did not attend the meeting, ⁧لَمْ تَقَعْ إِصَابَاتٌ⁩ There were no injuries. The juxtaposed is the third way of the imperfect: after the indicative (A2-03) and the conjunctive (A2-04), here the final vowel disappears completely, and in the weak verbs also shortens the internal vowel. It's the unit that really makes you read the news. Two weeks.

rows: A2 · Module A2.1 The verbal system
12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 57–58 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-05), voice synthesis script, tutor session in the second week
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. to form the juxtaposition of the regular verbs in all persons;
2. deny the past with ⁧لَمْ⁩ , even with weak verbs ( ⁧لَمْ يَكُنْ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَقُلْ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَأْتِ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَنْسَ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَرَ⁩ );
3. choose between ⁧مَا⁩ + perfect and ⁧لَمْ⁩ + negative according to the register;
4. use ⁧لَمْ⁩ … ⁧بَعْدُ⁩ Not... yet. ⁧لَمْ يَعُدْ⁩ Not... more... ⁧لَمَّا⁩ ;
5. understand short news and a report of teaching service full of denials;
6. tell a mishap and write a short report of 100 words.
Two-week plan.

What to notice. After ⁧لَمْ⁩ the verb loses the final vowel: ⁧لَمْ تَعْمَلْ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ أَجِدْ⁩ . In weak verbs the internal vowel is also shortened: ⁧يَكُونُ⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَكُنْ⁩ , ⁧يَقُولُ⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَقُلْ⁩ , ⁧تَأْتِي⁩ → ⁧لَمْ تَأْتِ⁩ , ⁧تَنْتَهِي⁩ → ⁧لَمْ تَنْتَهِ⁩ . In front of the article sukūn becomes i: ⁧لَمْ أَسْمَعِ المُنَبِّهَ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ تَرْكَبِ الحَافِلَةَ. لَمْ يَكُنْ⁩ , as ⁧كَانَ⁩ , wants the predicate to the accusative: ⁧لَمْ يَكُنْ طَوِيلًا. لَا تَسْأَلِي⁩ Do not ask!It is a prohibition: ⁧لَا⁩ +A2-06). ⁧بِسُرْعَةٍ⁩ Quickly, quickly. ⁧شَيْئًا مُهِمًّا⁩ : after a denial ⁧شَيْء⁩ it means "nothing" is "nothing."
2. The Jurissive ( ⁧المَجْزُوم⁩ ) e ⁧لَمْ⁩
The juxtaposition is obtained from the imperfect indicative with two changes:
1. the final -u disappears and the consonant remains with the sukūn: ⁧يَدْرُسُ⁩ → ⁧يَدْرُسْ⁩ ;
2. terminations -īna, -āni, -ūna They lose the -na / -ni , just like in the conjunctive: ⁧تَدْرُسِي⁩ , ⁧يَدْرُسَا⁩ ,
⁧يَدْرُسُوا⁩ .
The -na of the female plural remains: ⁧يَدْرُسْنَ⁩ .

blocks.text: The key point. ⁧لَمْ⁩ + juxive has past value, even if the form is that of the imperfect: ⁧لَمْ يَدْرُسْ⁩ It has not been studied, not studied. Time is in ⁧لَمْ⁩ Not in the verb. The support vowel. One sukūn followed by an alif waṣla (Article, ⁧اِسْم⁩ , ⁧اِبْن⁩ ...) takes one i: ⁧لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الوَزِيرُ⁩ (lam yaḥḍuri l-wazīr), ⁧لَمْ أَسْمَعِ الخَبَرَ⁩ . In texts without vowels, the regular juxtaposition is written as the indicative ( ⁧لم يدرس⁩ ): you recognize it from ⁧لَمْ⁩ . It is seen instead in the weak ( ⁧لم يكن⁩ , ⁧لم يأت⁩ , ⁧لم ير⁩ ) and in the forms that lose the ⁧ن⁩ ( ⁧لم يدرسوا⁩ ).
The meaning is the same, ... I don't have / isn't... Change log:

blocks.text: Example ⁧مَا جَاءَ أَحَدٌ.⁩ ⁧لَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ.⁩

In your conversations with the tutor you can use both; in written texts of this level (reports, formal emails, summaries) use ⁧لَمْ⁩ . In the news you'll find almost alone ⁧لَمْ⁩ . Warning: ⁧لَمْ⁩ It's only used with the juror. ⁧لَمْ ذَهَبَ⁩ (with the perfect) and ⁧لَمْ يَذْهَبُ⁩ (indicative) are errors.
4. The concave verbs to the juxtaposed
When the final vowel disappears, the syllable closes: a long vowel cannot be in a closed syllable, so it shortens. It is the same rule as the two bases of A2-02.

People with vowel suffix (tu f., duals, you, their sts) keep the vowel long, because the syllable remains open: ⁧لَمْ يَقُولُوا⁩ lam yaqūlū. ⁧لَمْ يَكُنْ⁩ is one of the most frequent forms of written language: ⁧لَمْ يَكُنِ الوَضْعُ سَهْلًا⁩ The situation was not easy to achieve. ⁧لَمْ يَكُنْ هُنَاكَ أَحَدٌ⁩ There was no one there. Assimilated and double. The equivalent is regular ( ⁧يَصِلُ⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَصِلْ⁩ , ⁧يَجِدُ⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَجِدْ⁩ ). In the doubles you find two forms, both correct: ⁧لَمْ يَرُدَّ⁩ (more common) and ⁧لَمْ يَرْدُدْ⁩ (more classic).
5. Verbs flawed to the juxtaposed; ⁧يَأْتِي⁩ and ⁧يَرَى⁩
In defects the final long vowel shortens:
⁧لَمْ يَبْقَيَبْقَى⁩ lam yabqa ⁧لَمْ يَبْقَوْا⁩

For "tu" (f.), "duals" and "their" the "nutritive" corresponds to the conjunction (A2-04Section 5). In texts without vowels these forms are immediately recognizable: ⁧لم يأت⁩ , ⁧لم ير⁩ , ⁧لم ينس⁩ , ⁧لم يمش⁩ have one less letter than the indication. If a form later ⁧لم⁩ It seems to have only two consonants, think of a defective or a concave.

⁧لَمَّا⁩ with the juxtaposed is literary: you find it in formal texts. Do not confuse it with ⁧لَمَّا⁩ + perfect, which means when (A2-14).
7. The lexicon of the facts
Short news and police reports use fixed formulas, almost always with ⁧لَمْ⁩ :

rows: The cause of the accident is not yet known. (recognize)

blocks.text: ⁧أُصِيبَ⁩ and ⁧يُعْرَفْ⁩ are passive forms (subject undergoes action): you will study in B1; For now recognize them as formulas. All the texts on facts of this course are didactic and invented: they do not describe facts or real people.
8. Pronunciation

The sukūn The final is heard. lam yadrus, lam aǧid, lam taʿmal: the final consonant closes clean, without vowel. In the indicative and regular juxtaposition pause they get confused (yadrus); in a phrase no: lam yadrus ad-dars? → lam yadrusi d-dars, with the support i. The short vowel of the weak. lam yakun, lam yaqul, lam yaʾti, lam yansa: short and fast vowels. Lam yakūnLam yaʾtīThe long vowel is exactly what the juxtaposed removes. ⁧لَمْ⁩ and ⁧لَنْ⁩ . Lam (passed) and lan (future) are distinguished only for the last consonant: keep it clear, m with lips closed, n with tongue on teeth.
